author: Codex
profile: Independent numeric nop2/nd8, no END/UP semantics; all256 possible8-bit data values are legal. Do not mix with AE1 control profiles
input: Q=01+two op information bits+0+eight data information bits+0; only binary Q plus current answer prefix enters original Model
answer: Echo op0 copies8 information bits, Neg op1 flips8 information bits; both append tail0, then external S target
question_pool: InputID=op*256+value; fixed order op0 values0..255, then op1 values0..255; all512 questions trained each epoch
train_values: All integers0..255 for both ops; no validation/heldout holes
schedule: np.random.default_rng(seed+221000);40 sequential permutation(512), mapped to frozen pool, actual40x512x(op,value) arrays frozen before any formal score
optimizer: Unmodified P030 Model.lesson/step/Adam lr.003 beta.9/.999 eps1e-8/global normclip1, float32 parameters/moments and original birth-age correction; fixed shape, no grow/router/separator/new task
initialization: Fresh original Model(seed,L23,H69), full p/m/v/birth/t/growth_rng plus seed/events/counters frozen per seed
generation: External wrapper with fixed16-action cap and original context-overflow check; generated prefix only, no true answer, answer-length cutoff or forcedSTOP. Do not use old generate8
stopping: After each complete epoch, greedy-generate all512 training Q. Increment streak only if Echo256/256 AND Neg256/256 exact whole outputs includingSTOP; otherwise reset0. Stop at streak2 or after40 epochs. No score-dependent schedule regeneration, extension, seed selection, checkpoint selection or retry
checkpoint: Save full state every epoch after its training-set probe, epoch loss sum/mean, pre-update target prediction correct counts, exact per-target canonical trace digest, all512 generated tokens, scores and streak/stop decision
trace: SHA256 of sequential canonical JSON lines [inputID,answer_position_zero_based,prediction_before_update,CE_loss] per epoch;5120 records. No per-target full-state hashing or trace-file IO. Full optimizer/RNG state directly compared at epoch endpoints
replay: Exactly one complete independent target-loop replay for seed101 from frozen initial state, after all primary seeds. Verify every epoch target loss/pred digest/count/aggregate, full state,512 generation results and stopping decision. Seeds202/303 are explicitly not planned for replay
final_evaluation: After all primary seeds and planned replay, reuse final epoch free-generation tokens, then compute full teacher-forcing logits/probabilities/CE for all512 Q and all10 true-prefix targets. No final optimizer update
costs: Report actual stopped-epoch training MAC/updates per seed, seed101 replay separately, every epoch greedy inference and final TF inference calls/MAC, array bytes, input/output sizes and walltime. Maximum values are caps, not claimed expenditure
gate: Prepare/freeze plus meaningful bounded synthetic engineering only before coordinator/reviewer gate and Git preregistration. Formal execute needs exact approved manifestSHA, prereg commit and new output directory
scope: Full finite8-bit-domain learning and retention during mixed Echo/Neg training. Necessary context and data-width changes mean this is not a pure question-count causal comparison with the earlier3-bit experiment
limits: No heldout/generalization test or unseen operand claim. Correct finite-domain performance does not prove unbounded algorithms, internal routing, physical growth or notification semantics
